name: CI Monitor Agent - Auto Fix Draft PR
prompt: Dynamic ci_*** label -> derive repo. Only recently pushed repos (24h), max 10 per run. Check Actions: fail -> broken branch. Before acting: if a draft PR already targets the broken branch, do NOT raise another PR until a change is made in the broken branch (new commit/updated files). Only then: get changed files (skip deleted); create fix branch FROM broken branch; apply fixes; push; open DRAFT PR targeting broken branch; assign review. Pass = ignore.
